Cheapest 8 GB VPS

Answer: As of 2026-10-31, among 2 orderable verified 8 GB RAM plans at 2 TB egress with backups, the cheapest true monthly cost is OVHcloud VPS-2 at $10.00/mo. The priciest in this slice is Hostinger VPS KVM 2 at $14.99/mo — a gap of $60/yr. Hetzner CX33 ($12.07/mo, EU only) is sold out on the provider’s page (checked 2026-10-31) and not ranked.
